verdict_reason: Rows read the stored code, common name and Latin name correctly, but the package-count rule it gates on has two packagesApply homes.

todos.issue: Whether a commodity code takes a number of packages has two homes, both changed in this PR: packagesApply in check-answers/view-model/applicability.js:34 (appliesForGateValue('numberOfPackages', code), used here) and packagesApply in commodities/consignment-details/fields.js:13 (commodities.packageCountCommodityCodes().includes(code)). Same name, two sources of truth, so the consignment-details page can ask for packages that check your answers then hides, or the other way round.
todos.fix: Must: one function decides whether a commodity code takes a package count, and both the consignment-details page and the check-answers species card call it. One way: keep the obligation-gate version (appliesForGateValue) and have consignment-details/fields.js import it, deleting its own packagesApply.
